Metadata.Title: (光头的处方)47‘s Prescription
Metadata.Description: 假药集团担保人沈医生及其CEO，团伙非法获利过亿，现正于马尔代夫度假。上月，47因枪伤医院挂号求药，沈医生竟提供假药；今日，47将亲赴阳光海岸，为全体开具“最终处方”。  The doctor and CEO of a counterfeit drug ring, who made over ¥100M and are vacationing in the Maldives. Last month, 47 sought help for a gunshot and got fake pills. Today, he's flying there to issue them a "final prescription."
